imaging.objective_identification: Mitutoyo M Plan Apo 5x / 0.14 marking readable in reference246; dimensions, sensor/relay scale and working distance remain estimates

geometry_basis: Photo243/245/246/247: photographed optical frame and covered manipulators; reference5 replaces rectangular/backed guide slots with through-cut rounded slots and replaces painted optical-cover slots with bounded recessed service wells and physical cover openings. Dimensions remain estimates.
reference5_construction: Rounded guide slots70x15 mm, recessed side cover slots17x5 mm and approximately12 mm service-well depth are photo estimates. Native compound contacts leave those openings accessible; objective/sample and control datums, clearance1 optical contacts and flexible cable definitions are unchanged.
alignment6_correction: Chuck clamp now rests on the lower rail, supports the unchanged chip underside and has 0.2 mm clearance to each side guide. Guide bases sit on the rail; short physical screw stems join the raised heads to the clamp. Added compound support contacts without changing objective, needle, specimen or control datums.
control_geometry_correction: Micrometer marks follow cylindrical barrels instead of protruding radial dial strips; contact envelopes cover complete thimbles, right blue sleeves and separate ratchets. Joint/grasp locations unchanged.
optical_contact_model: Dedicated optical/work-surface bits preserve existing robot and needle/pad contacts. Stepped objective end/aperture/glass and raised chuck clamp screws have explicit contacts; centered minimum-focus specimen gap is1.3 mm, while extreme chuck travel can meet a clamp screw. Retract the optical head before coarse chuck positioning.
assumptions: Unmarked stage pitches/travel estimated. Needle 120 µm contact radius is a numerically stable coarse proxy; electrical response is modeled separately.

contact_mechanics.coupling_relation: output = ratio * input; input/output/ratio metadata remains unchanged
contact_mechanics.friction_units: N m for hinge joints, N for slide joints
contact_mechanics.calibration: Numerical stabilization with estimated friction; no measured torque, compliance, backlash, or mass calibration is claimed.
contact_mechanics.scope: Preserves geometry, masses, inertias, existing gravity compensation, and active fixture forces. Adds no holding actuators or position overwrites.
limitations: Flexible hoses and fibers are visual surfaces without cable contact or strain physics.
Optical focus handwheels are fixed visual geometry; the optical-head slide has physics but no rotary handwheel transmission.
